title: p3 - make Claude interview you

beats.say: Want better AI answers? Stop writing prompts.
Nope. Make the AI interview you instead.

panel.label: Paste this
panel.text: Before you answer, ask me 5 questions one at a time about my goal, my audience and my constraints. Then give me the best answer.

beats.say: That is it. The AI learns what you actually want before it writes anything.
So no more vague, generic answers?
Exactly. Vague in, vague out. Specific in, useful out.

bubbles: Sure! First question: who is your customer?

beats.say: And you can build apps with that too?
Yes. Use code A T 100 on Base forty four for free credits. Link in bio.
Drop the topic you want an AI to interview you about.
